senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; חָנָה)tent, esp. tradesman’s shop, tavern; meat-market &c.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:16">Ab. III, 16</cite> <he>הח׳ פתוחה וכ׳</he> the shop is open, the shop-keeper gives on credit, i.e. man has free volition and Providence is long-suffering &c.—
<cite ref="Gittin 67a:8">Gitt. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ מיוזנת</he> well-stocked shop (a man of vast learning and readiness), v. <cite ref="J00261"><he>יָזַן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 6:3">Toh. VI, 3</cite> <he>ח׳ שהיא טמאה</he> ed. Dehr. (ed. <he>שהוא טמא</he>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲנֻיּ׳ חֲנוּיּוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Chullin 95a">Ḥull. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>תשע ח׳ וכ׳</he> if there are nine meat-shops (in one market) all of which sell &c.; <cite ref="Pesachim 9b">Pes. 9ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 18a">Nidd. 18ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 15a">Keth. 15ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 35b:4">Sabb. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>שניה להבטיל מלאכה מעיר וַחֲנוּיּוֹתֶיהָ</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>להבטיל עיר וחנויות</he>) the second signal was given to stop work in the town and in its shops.
<cite ref="Shabbat 35b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>וננעלו הח׳</he> and the stores were closed.

<cite ref="Shabbat 15a">Ib. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>גלתה … לה בח׳</he> the Sanhedrin were removed from the Temple and held their meetings in the market; (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 8b:11">Ab. Zar. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>בחנות</he>); a. fr.
